_note: Standing constraint recorded in CLAUDE.md: roughly 8B parameters overall, router included. The former 600M router-specific cap was lifted by Jahid on 2026-08-17 (ADR 0008); the key stays so the load-time assertion still runs. default_max_params was raised 8e9 -> 1e10 by Jahid on 2026-08-19 to admit Qwen3.5-9B as a decomposer model (ADR 0015, pending supervisor confirmation; if the 8B ceiling is reasserted, this reverts). The router cap is unchanged. Asserted in src/model_size.py at every model load. Changing a number here is Jahid's decision with his supervisor - not an agent's, and not a workaround for a model that fails the assertion.
_answerer_note: The MuSiQue answering backend's reader (issue #16, ADR 0019) gets its OWN key at 8e9 rather than sharing default_max_params. ADR 0015's raise to 1e10 was granted for one role - Qwen3.5-9B as a decomposer - and letting the reader inherit it would silently extend that exception to a role no ADR admits. So the reader stays under the standing ~8B ceiling: the default reader (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, ~7.25B) passes, and a 9B reader is refused at load time until Jahid records an extension for it. Raising this number is his decision with his supervisor.
